why: The page filter's list (the build loop's run 12, 2026-09-06). Every page whose sections have landed on an archetype is here, added the run its first section lands; `npm run harness:page` renders each entry with scripts/harness/render_page.tsx --list and checks every render with scripts/harness/check_page_holes.mjs --list. surface is the renderer's surface (country, howto, city, cell, industry, hood), slugs its arguments, since the run that added the page. The coverage gate reds when a page folder has a section on an archetype and no entry here names its surface.
